_comment: One evaluation case. Add it as a single line to private/eval/questions.jsonl (JSON Lines: one object per line, without this _comment field). All 'expect' checks are optional; a case passes when every check it lists passes.
turns: The visitor's message. Add more strings for a multi-turn conversation; only the final reply is checked for include/sources.

expect._include: Each inner list is a group of alternatives; the final reply must contain one phrase from every group (case-insensitive).
exclude: text that must not appear in any reply
expect._exclude_patterns: Regular expressions that must not match any reply, e.g. a dollar figure the website never publishes.
expect._sources_any: The final reply must link or cite at least one of these (mirror copies of the same report count).
expect._outcome_any: Outcome the assistant should log: answered, referred_to_resource, referred_to_staff, escalated, no_answer_found, out_of_scope, safety_redirect.
expect._log_exclude: Strings that must not appear in anything the case stored (interaction log, escalations).

notes: Where the expected answer comes from on the website, so a reviewer can check the expectation.
